left_out_parameters.because: It acknowledges the risk of downloading a file flagged as malware or abuse, which a call never does for the person who connected

global_parameters.says: With `alt=media`, the call answers the text of the file where the runtime reads its type, a text file, a PDF or a Word document, and otherwise its type and its size.

descriptions.says: Creates a file with no content, such as a folder, with the MIME type `application/vnd.google-apps.folder`, or a shortcut, with `application/vnd.google-apps.shortcut`. To save a text as a file, call `drive.files.create.upload`.
descriptions.because: Google's description of the method describes its upload too, which this operation does not send: it sends the file's metadata alone, as JSON

descriptions.says: Saves a text as a file in the person's Google Drive, its name and its content in one call. `body` is a list of two items: first the file's metadata, then the text. Give the text alone, and it is sent as plain text, or as `{ "media_type": …, "text": … }` to say what the text is, such as `text/markdown`, `text/html` or `text/csv`. Give `name` in the metadata with its extension, such as `report.md`. Give `parents` in the metadata as one folder's id; without it the file is placed directly in the person's My Drive folder. Without `mimeType` the file keeps the text as it is. To convert it, give `mimeType` in the metadata: `application/vnd.google-apps.document` for a Google Doc, `application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet` for a Google Sheet. Google converts the text as the media type it is given with: give Markdown or HTML with its media type for a formatted Doc, and CSV with its media type for a Sheet with columns. Convert only when the person asks for a Google Doc or Sheet; when they have not said whether they want one or the file as it is, ask them before you call. To make a repeat of the call safe, take an id from `drive.files.generateIds` first and give it as `id` in the metadata: a repeat is then answered 409 and no second file is created. An id cannot be given together with a conversion. Ask for `fields=id,name,webViewLink` to answer the file's link.
descriptions.because: Google's description of the method gives the upload's protocols and sizes, which an agent cannot act on; this says what the upload takes and what Google does with it, in Google's words where it has them
